metadata.question: Did the Lut Desert experience land surface temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius in 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS LST products (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) for land surface temperature - Date: Year 2018 (full year) - Location: Lut Desert, Iran (approximately 30.5°N, 59°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to mask low-quality pixels - No cloud masking needed for LST data (already processed) - The question asks about temperature thresholds, not clouds 3. Logic: - Valid result: If max temperature > 75°C → A (Yes), else → B (No) - C1: No images found in collection - C2: No valid pixels after QA masking - C3: Temperature value is None, NaN, or unrealistic (e.g., >100°C or <-100°C) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lut Desert location (central coordinates) const lutDesert = ee.Geometry.Point([59.0, 30.5]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius // 2. Load MODIS LST data for 2018 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate('2018-01-01', '2018-12-31') .filterBounds(lutDesert); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Collection size (MOD11A1):', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try Terra+Aqua combined product collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1') .filterDate('2018-01-01', '2018-12-31') .filterBounds(lutDesert); const fallbackSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Fallback collection size (MYD11A1):', fallbackSize); if (fallbackSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS LST images found for Lut Desert in 2018.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Process LST data: Convert from Kelvin to Celsius and apply QA mask const processLST = (image) => { const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Scale and convert K to C const qa = image.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // Keep only good quality (mandatory QA bits 0-1) return lst.updateMask(mask); }; const lstCollection = collection.map(processLST); // 4. Calculate maximum temperature across all images const maxLST = lstCollection.max(); // 5. Get statistics const stats = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lutDesert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTemp = stats.LST_Day_1km_max; const pixelCount = stats.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log('Valid pixels:', pixelCount); console.log('Maximum LST (C):', maxTemp ? maxTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'); // 6. Validation and final answer if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || isNaN(maxTemp)) { console.log('Temperature calculation returned invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTemp > 100 || maxTemp < -100) { console.log('Temperature value outside realistic range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Final determination if (maxTemp > 75) { console.log('Lut Desert exceeded 75C in 2018.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Lut Desert did not exceed 75C in 2018.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
